title: Spaceman Dela releases a wonderful single "DIVE IN"
htmlContent:
Canadian-based artist Spaceman Dela releases a wonderful single called "DIVE IN," a smooth, late night banger produced by Hardbody Jones. "DIVE IN" is the perfect record for the times, as he gives you a fresh sound that gets more enjoyable with every listen.

The single "DIVE IN" is impressive in every way from the production, smooth vocals, and well crafted lyrics to make sure it’s a record you keep on repeat for time to come. If you love good music, only thing you have to do is hit play and enjoy the music and visuals alike. The vocal performance is superb in its tone, as it gives you something you can feel, with a smoothness that delivers with ease, to make sure the writing is delivered to perfection.

Stream DIVE IN by Spaceman Dela.
